From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing inputs for BrightLoop (internal)

Forwarding Sasha's traffic sketch + ask. Internal notes for pricing:

- Cost-of-serving estimate (infra + margin) for similar workload: ~$10–$18 / 1M tokens at our hosted stack (depends heavily on sequence length and quantization profile).
- Typical discount sizing: PAYG list $140 / 1M (example), 3mo commit 10–20% off, 12mo commit 25–40% off for high-volume deals. For the $70–$95 target Sasha mentioned, BrightLoop would be in range with ~25–35% commit discount off list for 62M tokens/month.
- Peak TPS note: To support 200 TPS 99th for a 30s window reliably, recommend reserved commit with a burst pool (dedicated capacity fallback) or explicit burst allowance. Otherwise PAYG can see throttling during sustained spikes.

Draft proposal idea to hand procurement:
1) 3-month pilot: 48M/mo baseline, $110 / 1M PAYG-equivalent with a 20% pilot discount ($88 / 1M) — quick time-to-value, short MPA
2) 12-month reserved: commit to 50M–70M/mo tranches; price example $75 / 1M with SLA for 99th TPS and burst headroom (explicitly carve out 300 TPS pooled burst for nightly jobs)

I'll attach a draft MPA and a short one-pager. Please review and flag any legal/SLA asks before I send to BrightLoop.

Attachments: draft_mpa_redwood_v1.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

—Marissa
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing inputs for BrightLoop (internal)

Thanks for the summary — solid. A few edits and the go-forward: 

- Do not promise PAYG list numbers to procurement. Frame PAYG as an upper bound; emphasize commit pricing for sustained workloads with burst protections.
- Proposed official quote to BrightLoop:
  * Pilot (3mo): 48M/mo baseline — introductory rate $88 / 1M (pilot discount), includes soft burst up to 250 TPS for 60s windows.
  * Annual reserved (12mo): tiered commit with volume slab — 50–70M/mo slab priced at $75 / 1M with SLA for 99th percentile latency and explicit 300 TPS pooled burst allocation. Add a clause: automatic fallback to compatible smaller model if committed pool exhausted, to preserve availability.

- Ask procurement for (a) a short list of compliance docs they need (SOC2/ISO), (b) confirmation of billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly), and (c) contact for legal to accept our MPA redline.

Nikhil — send the one-pager and the redlineable MPA to Sasha + procure@brightloop.ai. Marissa — I'll approve the numbers above; include the SKU logic (how token math maps to invoice lines) in the one-pager.

Karthik
Head of Sales — Hosted API, Redwood Inference
